svg.aria-label: Lanes. Visitor and operator on the left, one gateway with ingress, identity, static, wake with the Guard, scheduler and admin stages, then three runtime lanes: container on the Docker engine and /data volumes, isolate as one worker thread per app on the runner service and its volume, static with no process on the bundle store. Edges to Redis, the object store and the runner are labelled with the number of apps that declare each capability; PostgreSQL and coturn are off because no app needs them. A request reaches each lane in turn: the container app wakes in about 260 ms, the isolate app in 62 to 87 ms, and the static site is answered from the bundle store with no wake.
svg.title: Lanes
svg.text: One gateway, three runtimes, each on its own base. An edge counts the apps that declare that capability.
